changes.text: That year the Qianlong emperor, Hongli, pressed provincial officials over their failure to catch the sorcerers' leaders. Philip A. Kuhn, the historian who reconstructed the panic, points out that the emperor could turn his anger on provincial officials who failed to catch those leaders. They could not avoid failing, because no such leader existed. Kuhn also insists that Hongli did not see the absurdity of the case at the time. The governors faced an emperor who was in earnest about the hunt, and a quarry that could not be caught.
叫魂案收场时，孔飞力写道，弘历以在官僚中寻找替罪羊来结束清剿，要借处罚失职官员表明他的清剿是正确的。被单独挑出来重罚的是苏尔德。叫魂案在苏州刚发生时，他在任上却没有陈奏；后来做山西巡抚，又「清剿阻挠尤甚」，也就是阻挠清剿最厉害。弘历把他贬为省按察使，发往新疆。吴绍诗则安然度过了这场危机：弘历不但没有斥责他，第二年还任命他为刑部尚书。

When the soulstealing affair ended, Kuhn writes, Hongli brought the campaign to a close by looking for scapegoats among his officials, and he meant to show, by punishing their failures, that his campaign had been right. The official singled out for heavy punishment was Su'erde. He had been serving in Suzhou when the first cases broke out there and had not reported them. Later, as governor of Shanxi, he "obstructed the suppression most of all." Hongli demoted him to provincial judicial commissioner and sent him off to Xinjiang. Wu Shaoshi, by contrast, came through the crisis unharmed. Far from rebuking him, Hongli appointed him president of the Board of Punishments the following year.
风险同样有记录可查。弘历在吴绍诗的这段警告上批了「恐属空言」；「老菩萨」的名声和消极误事的担心，危机前一年就摆在了皇帝面前；苏尔德的下场则说明，清剿收场时弘历要在官员中找替罪羊，不报和阻挠的人可能被单独挑出来重罚。本文作者推断，吴绍诗躲过去，很大程度上靠的是别人借不来的条件，同样的做法换一个人，换来的可能是另一种朱批。

The risks are on record too. Hongli wrote "I fear these are empty words" in response to Wu Shaoshi's warning. The Old Bodhisattva nickname, and the worry that he was too passive, had reached the emperor a year before the crisis. Su'erde's fate shows that when the campaign ended and Hongli looked for scapegoats among his officials, those who had failed to report or had obstructed the campaign could be singled out for heavy punishment. My inference is that Wu Shaoshi got through largely on advantages no one else could borrow. Another official doing the same thing might have received a very different rescript.

dispositions.rationale: 英文末句原写弘历对每道命令都字字当真，证据只说他当时没有察觉案件荒谬。现改为“an emperor who was in earnest about the hunt”，与中文“一位认真追究的皇帝”对齐。中文不变。

evidence.quote: 叫魂案件虽如此荒谬，但弘历在当时却对此并无察觉

dispositions.rationale: 在苏尔德一句前补入孔飞力对收场处罚性质的交代：弘历以找替罪羊结束清剿，借处罚失职官员表明清剿正确。中英同步修改，ev 增加 E22。富尼汉没有展开。

evidence.quote: 恼羞成怒的弘历以在官僚中寻找替罪羊来结束对叫魂案的清剿
只有通过处罚这些官员的失职，他才能向世人和后代昭告，他的清剿是正确的
苏尔德被单独挑出来受到特别惩处

dispositions.rationale: 原句把苏尔德的下场写成不报、阻挠的一般后果。现改为限定在清剿收场、弘历找替罪羊的情形下，不报和阻挠的人可能被单独挑出来重罚。中英同步修改，ev 增加 E22。
